items.name: composer
items.title: Composer
items.description: Message composer with live SMS segment counting and unicode detection.

items.name: thread
items.title: Thread
items.description: A full SMS conversation: polled history, delivery states, opt-out awareness, and a wired composer.

items.name: delivery-status
items.title: Delivery status
items.description: The queued/sent/delivered/failed indicator for an outbound message.

items.name: message-bubble
items.title: Message bubble
items.description: A single SMS/MMS bubble: direction alignment, media previews, optimistic pending state, timestamp and delivery status.

items.name: date-divider
items.title: Date divider
items.description: A centered day label between message groups: Today, Yesterday, weekday, or short date.

items.name: message-group
items.title: Message group
items.description: A run of consecutive same-direction messages, stacked tightly with a single timestamp on the last bubble.

items.name: inbox
items.title: Inbox
items.description: Polling conversation list with previews, relative times, STOP badges, and infinite scroll.

items.name: messaging
items.title: Messaging
items.description: Complete two-pane texting surface: inbox plus active thread, responsive down to mobile.

items.name: voicemail-player
items.title: Voicemail player
items.description: Voicemail list and player: audio playback with expiry-safe URL refresh, durations, and transcripts.

items.name: voicemail-inbox
items.title: Voicemail inbox
items.description: A voicemail list with unread tracking and the full player inline on the open row.

items.name: click-to-call-button
items.title: Click-to-call button
items.description: A call button that dials the agent, bridges the customer, and narrates the call's lifecycle live.

items.name: call-transcript
items.title: Call transcript
items.description: Speaker-labeled call transcript view — one-shot for finished calls or polling for live ones.

items.name: agent-assist
items.title: Agent assist panel
items.description: Give it the number your agent is talking to: it finds the active call, turns on live transcription, streams the conversation and keypad events in real time, and shows the AI summary after hangup.

items.name: call-keypad
items.title: Call keypad view
items.description: A call's keypad story — gather prompts with the digits the caller answered, loose keypresses, and digits sent to the far end. Renders nothing for calls without keypad activity.

items.name: call-log
items.title: Call log
items.description: Call history with direction icons, outcomes, durations, and expandable transcripts.

items.name: opt-in-form
items.title: Opt-in form
items.description: A carrier-compliant SMS opt-in form whose shape survived a real TCR review — optional consent checkbox, full CTIA disclosure, explicit not-enrolled path.

items.name: number-picker
items.title: Number picker
items.description: Area-code search and one-click purchase — the self-serve 'pick your business number' onboarding step.

items.name: port-status
items.title: Port status
items.description: A port-in request as a stepper — draft, review, confirmed date, done — with carrier rejections surfaced as fixable callouts.

items.name: texting-readiness
items.title: Texting readiness
items.description: A number's path to messaging as a checklist: active, campaign attached, carrier approved. 10DLC without the mystery.

items.name: brand-registration-form
items.title: Brand registration form
items.description: A 10DLC brand registration form: legal identity, EIN, and business contact, validated and POSTed to /brands.

items.name: campaign-registration-form
items.title: Campaign registration form
items.description: A 10DLC campaign registration form: use case, description, 2–5 sample messages, and opt-in details, POSTed to /campaigns.

items.name: e911-address-form
items.title: E911 address form
items.description: An E911 emergency-address form for a tenant's numbers, validated and POSTed to /e911_addresses.

items.name: compliance-status
items.title: Compliance status
items.description: Tracks 10DLC brand and campaign approval: status badge, rejection reason, and assigned throughput; polls while pending.

items.name: usage-meter
items.title: Usage meter
items.description: A tenant's period usage as labeled quantities with comparative bars — show or re-bill customers their own traffic.

items.name: event-log
items.title: Event log
items.description: A live realtime event inspector: envelopes newest-first, filterable by type, raw payload expandable per row.

items.name: contact-timeline
items.title: Contact timeline
items.description: One customer's entire relationship in one scroll — messages, calls with transcripts, and voicemails merged newest-first. Built for CRM contact panels.

items.name: phone-system
items.title: Phone system
items.description: Texting, call history, and voicemail behind three tabs — the whole phone system as one component.

items.name: dialer
items.title: Dialer
items.description: A phone keypad: type or tap a number and call from the browser. In-call keys send DTMF.

items.name: dtmf-pad
items.title: DTMF pad
items.description: The in-call keypad: sends tones on the active call for extensions, PINs, and press-1 menus, with real dual-tone audio feedback.

items.name: call-hud
items.title: Call HUD
items.description: The in-call bar: who you're talking to, a live timer, mute, hang up — with an optional pop-out keypad. Renders nothing while quiet.

items.name: incoming-call-toast
items.title: Incoming call toast
items.description: Rings on screen when a call comes in — caller number, answer, decline. Mount once; silent until it rings.

items.name: softphone
items.title: Softphone
items.description: A phone that lives inside your product: connection status, dialer, in-call controls, and inbound ringing in one panel.

items.name: next-routes
items.title: Next.js proxy routes
items.description: Server route that proxies Handset UI components to the Handset API. Your API key stays server-side; tenant scoping hooks into your session.

items.name: express-routes
items.title: Express proxy routes
items.description: Express router that proxies Handset UI components to the Handset API. Your API key stays server-side; tenant scoping hooks into your session. Mount at /api/handset.

items.name: remix-routes
items.title: Remix / React Router proxy routes
items.description: Resource route that proxies Handset UI components to the Handset API — works on Remix v2 and React Router 7. Your API key stays server-side; tenant scoping hooks into your session.
